name: Original taken/untaken Iron Claymore world focus on cold load

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local elapsed=0;local frames=0;local total=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1;total=total+dt;elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<.2 then return end;elapsed=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during claymore focus observation')
 local source=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0xc56f9))
 local valid=source and source:isValid();local count=valid and source.count or -1;local enabled=valid and tostring(source.enabled) or 'unavailable'
 local scene=0;for _,item in ipairs(nearby.items) do if item==source then scene=scene+1 end end
 local owned=types.Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x1c6cd))
 print('FocusProbe sample count='..count..' scene='..scene..' owned='..owned..' enabled='..enabled..' valid='..tostring(valid))
 if frames>=30 and total>=1 then print('FocusProbe ready') end
end}}}}
